lifeScaleRandMin.doc: Min/max multipliers for lifetime applied to this bullet when spawned.

lifeScaleRandMax.doc: Min/max multipliers for lifetime applied to this bullet when spawned.

velocityScaleRandMin.doc: Min/max multipliers for velocity applied to this bullet when spawned.

velocityScaleRandMax.doc: Min/max multipliers for velocity applied to this bullet when spawned.

angleOffset.doc: Angle offset applied to bullet when spawned each time.

randomAngleOffset.doc: Angle offset applied to bullet when spawned each time.

pierceDamageFactor.doc: Multiplier of damage decreased per health pierced.

maxDamageFraction.doc: If positive, limits non-splash damage dealt to a fraction of the target's maximum health.

removeAfterPierce.doc: If false, this bullet isn't removed after pierceCap is exceeded. Expert usage only.

laserAbsorb.doc: For piercing lasers, setting this to true makes it get absorbed by plastanium walls.

optimalLifeFract.doc: Life fraction at which this bullet has the best range/damage/etc. Used for lasers and continuous turrets.

shootPattern.doc: Pattern used to shoot this bullet. If null, uses turret's default pattern.

chargeEffect.doc: Effect created when charging starts; only usable in single-shot weapons with a firstShotDelay / shotDelay.

smokeEffect.doc: Extra smoke effect created when shooting.

shootSound.doc: Overrides the shoot sound in turrets if set. Does nothing in units, as they can't have multiple ammo types.

hitSound.doc: Sound made when hitting something or getting removed.

despawnSound.doc: Sound made when hitting something or getting removed.

hitSoundPitch.doc: Pitch of the sound made when hitting something

hitSoundPitchRange.doc: Pitch of the sound made when hitting something

hitSoundVolume.doc: Volume of the sound made when hitting something

ammoMultiplier.doc: How many bullets get created per ammo item/liquid.

reloadMultiplier.doc: Multiplied by turret reload speed to get final shoot speed.

buildingDamageMultiplier.doc: Multiplier of how much base damage is done to tiles.

shieldDamageMultiplier.doc: Multiplier of how much base damage is done to force shields.

killShooter.doc: Whether to kill the shooter when this is shot. For suicide bombers.

instantDisappear.doc: Whether to instantly make the bullet disappear.

splashDamage.doc: Damage dealt in splash. 0 to disable.

scaledSplashDamage.doc: If true, splash damage is "correctly" affected by unit hitbox size. Used for projectiles that do not collide / have splash as their main source of damage.

impact.doc: Should knockback follow the bullet's direction

statusDuration.doc: Intensity of applied status effect in terms of duration.

targetBlocks.doc: Turret only. If false, blocks will not be targeted.

targetMissiles.doc: Turret only. If false, missiles will not be targeted.

collidesTiles.doc: Whether this bullet type collides with tiles.

collidesTeam.doc: Whether this bullet type collides with tiles that are of the same team.

collidesAir.doc: Whether this bullet type collides with air/ground units.

collidesGround.doc: Whether this bullet type collides with air/ground units.

collides.doc: Whether this bullet types collides with anything at all.

collideFloor.doc: If true, this projectile collides with non-surface floors.

collideTerrain.doc: If true, this projectile collides with static walls

keepVelocity.doc: Whether velocity is inherited from the shooter.

scaleKeepVelocity.doc: If keepVelocity = true, whether to reduce lifetime proportionally to the added speed, making range consistent.

scaleLife.doc: Whether to scale lifetime (not actually velocity!) to disappear at the target position. Used for artillery.

hittable.doc: Whether this bullet can be hit by point defense.

reflectable.doc: Whether this bullet can be reflected.

absorbable.doc: Whether this projectile can be absorbed by shields.

ignoreSpawnAngle.doc: If true, the angle param in create is ignored.

createChance.doc: Chance for this bullet to be created.

rangeOverride.doc: When > 0, overrides range even if smaller than base range.

rangeChange.doc: When used in a turret with multiple ammo types, this can be set to a non-zero value to influence range.

extraRangeMargin.doc: When used in turrets with limitRange() applied, this adds extra range to the bullets that extends past targeting range. Only particularly relevant in vanilla.

minRangeChange.doc: When used in a turret with multiple ammo types, this can be set to a non-zero value to influence minRange

healAmount.doc: flat amount of block health healed

healSound.doc: sound played when a block is healed

lifesteal.doc: Fraction of bullet damage that heals that shooter.

makeFire.doc: Whether to make fire on impact

hitUnder.doc: Whether this bullet will always hit blocks under it.

despawnHit.doc: Whether to create hit effects on despawn. Forced to true if this bullet has any special effects like splash damage. Disable setDefaults to avoid override

fragOnHit.doc: If true, this bullet will create bullets when it hits anything

fragOnDespawn.doc: If true, this bullet will create bullets when it despawns

fragOnAbsorb.doc: If false, this bullet will not create frags when absorbed by a shield.

pierceArmor.doc: If true, unit armor is ignored in damage calculations.

armorMultiplier.doc: Multiplies the unit/building armor used in damage calculations. Used for armor weakness, armor piercing, and anti-armor.

blockArmorMultiplier.doc: Multiplies only the building armor used in damage calculations.

sticky.doc: If true, the bullet will "stick" to enemies and get deactivated on collision.

stickyExtraLifetime.doc: Extra time added to bullet when it sticks to something.

setDefaults.doc: Whether status and despawnHit should automatically be set.

hitShake.doc: Amount of shaking produced when this bullet hits something or despawns.

despawnShake.doc: Amount of shaking produced when this bullet hits something or despawns.

fragBullet.doc: Bullet type that is created when this bullet expires.

delayFrags.doc: If true, frag bullets are delayed to the next frame. Fixes obscure bugs with piercing bullet types spawning frags immediately and screwing up the Damage temporary variables.

fragRandomSpread.doc: Degree spread range of fragmentation bullets.

fragSpread.doc: Uniform spread between each frag bullet in degrees.

fragVelocityMin.doc: Random range of frag velocity as a multiplier.

fragVelocityMax.doc: Random range of frag velocity as a multiplier.

fragLifeMin.doc: Random range of frag lifetime as a multiplier.

fragLifeMax.doc: Random range of frag lifetime as a multiplier.

fragOffsetMin.doc: Random offset of frag bullets from the parent bullet.

fragOffsetMax.doc: Random offset of frag bullets from the parent bullet.

pierceFragCap.doc: How many times this bullet can release frag bullets, if pierce = true.

intervalBullet.doc: Bullet that is created at a fixed interval.

bulletInterval.doc: Interval, in ticks, between which bullet spawn.

intervalBullets.doc: Number of bullet spawned per interval.

intervalRandomSpread.doc: Random angle added to interval bullets.

intervalSpread.doc: Angle spread between individual interval bullets.

intervalDelay.doc: Use a negative value to disable interval bullet delay.

underwater.doc: If true, this bullet is rendered underwater. Highly experimental!

healColor.doc: Color used for block heal effects.

healEffect.doc: Effect emitted upon blocks that are healed.

spawnBullets.doc: Bullets spawned when this bullet is created. Rarely necessary, used for visuals.

showStats.doc: Whether to display the stats of the spawned bullet.

spawnBulletRandomSpread.doc: Random angle spread of spawn bullets.

spawnUnit.doc: Unit spawned _instead of_ this bullet. Useful for missiles.

despawnUnit.doc: Unit spawned when this bullet hits something or despawns due to it hitting the end of its lifetime.

despawnUnitChance.doc: The chance for despawn units to spawn.

despawnUnitCount.doc: Amount of units spawned when this bullet despawns.

despawnUnitRadius.doc: Random offset distance from the original bullet despawn/hit coordinate.

faceOutwards.doc: If true, units spawned when this bullet despawns face away from the bullet instead of the same direction as the bullet.

parts.doc: Extra visual parts for this bullet.

trailChance.doc: Chance of trail effect spawning on bullet per tick.

trailInterval.doc: Uniform interval in which trail effect is spawned.

trailMinVelocity.doc: Min velocity required for trail effect to spawn.

trailParam.doc: Rotation/size parameter that is passed to trail. Usually, this controls size.

trailRotation.doc: Whether the parameter passed to the trail is the bullet rotation, instead of a flat value.

trailInterp.doc: Interpolation for trail width as function of bullet lifetime

trailLength.doc: Length of trail quads. Any value <= 0 disables the trail.

trailSinMag.doc: If trailSinMag > 0, these values are applied as a sine curve to trail width.

trailSinScl.doc: If trailSinMag > 0, these values are applied as a sine curve to trail width.

circleShooter.doc: If true, the bullet will attempt to circle around its shooting entity.

circleShooterRadius.doc: Radius that the bullet attempts to circle at.

circleShooterRadiusSmooth.doc: Smooth extra radius value for circling.

circleShooterRotateSpeed.doc: Multiplier of speed that is used to adjust velocity when circling.

splashDamageRadius.doc: Use a negative value to disable splash damage.

splashDamagePierce.doc: If true, splash damage pierces through tiles.

incendAmount.doc: Amount of fires attempted around bullet.

homingPower.doc: Power of bullet ability. Usually a number between 0 and 1; try 0.1 as a starting point.

homingRange.doc: Range of homing effect around bullet.

homingDelay.doc: Use a negative value to disable homing delay.

followAimSpeed.doc: Speed at which bullet rotates to follow cursor. <= 0 to disable.

suppressionRange.doc: Range of healing block suppression effect.

suppressionDuration.doc: Duration of healing block suppression effect.

suppressionEffectChance.doc: Chance of suppression effect occurring on block, scaled down by number of blocks.

suppressColor.doc: Color used for the regenSuppressSeek effect.

lightningColor.doc: Color of lightning created by bullet.

lightningLengthRand.doc: Extra random length added onto base length of lightning.

lightningDamage.doc: Use a negative value to use default bullet damage.

lightningCone.doc: Spread of lightning, relative to bullet rotation.

lightningAngle.doc: Offset of lightning relative to bullet rotation.

lightningType.doc: The bullet created at lightning points.

weaveScale.doc: Scale of bullet weave pattern. Higher -> less vibration.

weaveMag.doc: Intensity of bullet weaving. Note that this may make bullets inaccurate.

weaveRandom.doc: If true, the bullet weave will randomly switch directions on spawn.

rotateSpeed.doc: Rotation speed of the bullet velocity as it travels.

puddleRange.doc: Range of puddles around bullet position.

puddleAmount.doc: Liquid count of each puddle created.

puddleLiquid.doc: Liquid that puddles created are made of.

displayAmmoMultiplier.doc: Whether to display the ammo multiplayer for this bullet type in its stats.

statLiquidConsumed.doc: If >0, this is displayed divided by the ammo multiplier.

lightRadius.doc: Radius of light emitted by this bullet; <0 to use defaults.

lightColor.doc: Color of light emitted by this bullet.

minfo.doc: Info on which mod this content was loaded from.

removed.doc: If true, this content is invalid (added in a data patch and then removed).
